title: Marguerite and the Verdict
author: Yara Yarrow
blurb: Felix Fairweather, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
